name: brisksms-monorepo
description: BriskSMS - Commercial Payment Intelligence, Reconciliation, Business Automation, and Messaging Platform
author: BriskSMS Team

scripts.build: bun build --target node packages/shared/src/index.ts --outdir packages/shared/dist && bun build --target node --external @brisksms/shared packages/db/src/index.ts --outdir packages/db/dist && bun build --target node --external @brisksms/shared packages/parser-engine/src/index.ts --outdir packages/parser-engine/dist && bun build --target node --external @brisksms/shared packages/ui/src/index.ts --outdir packages/ui/dist && bun build --target node --external @brisksms/shared packages/zapier-app/src/index.ts --outdir packages/zapier-app/dist && bun build --target node --external @brisksms/shared --external @brisksms/db apps/worker/src/index.ts --outdir apps/worker/dist
scripts.test: bun test packages/shared/test/ packages/parser-engine/test/ packages/ui/test/ apps/api/test/ packages/zapier-app/test/
